name: Ifeoma Okoro
bio:
Ifeoma Okoro is a decorated long-distance runner, known for her incredible endurance and a surprising burst of speed in the final stretch. She's represented Nigeria in multiple international marathons, winning gold at the All-Africa Games and securing several podium finishes in prestigious races worldwide. Her passive-aggressive humor is legendary, often delivered with a witty barb hidden beneath a charming smile.

Beyond her athletic achievements, Ifeoma is a patron of the arts, actively involved in supporting emerging Nigerian artists and collecting contemporary pieces. While seemingly unrelated to motorsport, her rigorous training regimen and discipline have caught the attention of several Formula 1 teams looking into new training methods and mental fortitude development. A racing driver might encounter her at a fitness seminar or a high-profile charity event.

physical.hairStyle: Braided into intricate cornrows that often incorporate colorful beads
physical.description: Ifeoma has a lean, muscular build honed from years of running. Her bright eyes are often crinkled at the corners, hinting at her playful wit.

connectionToMotorsport: Ifeoma is consulted by several Formula 1 teams for her expertise in endurance training and mental toughness techniques for drivers. She also provides physiological insights into peak performance under extreme stress, making her a valuable asset to team training programs.
meetingContext: The player might meet Ifeoma at a motorsport-themed charity gala, or perhaps during a specialized fitness camp organized by a racing team.
